# ar5iv – Articles from arXiv.org as responsive HTML5 web documents

> A modern HTML5 web platform that transforms arXiv preprints into responsive, accessible documents using advanced LaTeX-to-HTML conversion technology.

ar5iv provides an alternative viewing interface for academic papers from arXiv.org, leveraging LaTeXML and HTML5 to create beautifully formatted, mobile-friendly scholarly documents. The platform preserves the full content and structure of scientific preprints while enhancing readability and accessibility across devices.

- HTML5

## Platform Overview

- [ar5iv – Articles from arXiv.org as responsive HTML5 web documents](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/): Main homepage showcasing ar5iv's modern HTML5 web view for arXiv preprints with responsive design and enhanced readability

## Sample Articles

- [[1910.06709] A Simple Proof of the Quadratic Formula](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/1910.06709): arXiv preprint by Po-Shen Loh presenting an elegant pedagogical approach to deriving the quadratic formula through completing-the-square
- [[2002.08888] The Forgotten Life of Mileva Marić Einstein](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2002.08888): arXiv preprint by Pauline Gagnon exploring the life and contributions of Mileva Marić Einstein in scientific history
